snippet.title: Pass Tiger Cage // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3771660/Pass_Tiger_Cage/

A Roguelike game. You will play a general in the game who leads his troops to guard the historical gate. Choose from a variety of combat skills, upgrade your equipment and recruit troops to assist in the battle.

Developed by
中军MT
